title: ZTF J0440+2325 and ZTF J1444+4820: data and analysis code
description: Reduced photometry (HiPERCAM), spectroscopy (Keck/LRIS and Keck/ESI), radial velocities, MESA brown dwarf evolutionary tracks, and custom analysis code (the mass-radius MCMC behind Table 1 and the ballistic stream simulation behind Figure 3) for Householder et al. (2026), 'Stars stably accreting from substellar objects,' Nature Astronomy.
